text: participant needs inputs components apply age. survey recorded: 16-item MEPA diet questionnaire everyone (children aged 2-5 use 10 items, sweets include sugar-sweetened beverages); daily active play children aged 2-5, weekly moderate vigorous activity minutes age 6; nicotine exposure, secondhand smoke, sleep; BMI adults, CDC BMI percentile percent 95th percentile children; non-HDL cholesterol glucose, blood drawn; blood pressure, child’s AAP 2017 90th 95th percentile thresholds ages 1-12. real project, children’s growth-chart blood-pressure reference values come height, weight, sex, age add_pediatric_references(), uses packages cdcanthro pedbp: simulation leaves gaps real survey : fifth adults nearly half children blood drawn, lipid glucose values. Blood drawn often participants higher BMI, whose cholesterol glucose also run higher. default, missing values imputed: score_le8(impute = FALSE). set TRUE, function uses multiple imputation predictive mean matching fill missing values.
code: survey <- add_pediatric_references(   survey,   sex = "sex",   height = "height_cm",   weight = "weight_kg" ) set.seed(2026) n <- 500  age <- c(   sample(2:5, 50, replace = TRUE),   sample(6:12, 60, replace = TRUE),   sample(13:19, 60, replace = TRUE),   sample(20:79, n - 170, replace = TRUE) ) child <- age < 20 preschool <- age < 6 under_13 <- age < 13 sex <- sample(c("female", "male"), n, replace = TRUE) clamp <- function(x, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf) pmin(pmax(x, lower), upper) diabetes <- !child & runif(n) < plogis(-4.2 + 0.05 * age) smoking_status <- case_when(   age < 13 ~ "never",   child ~ sample(c("never", "former", "current"), n, TRUE, c(0.8, 0.15, 0.05)),   .default = sample(c("never", "former", "current"), n, TRUE, c(0.58, 0.28, 0.14)) ) bmi_percentile <- if_else(child, round(clamp(rbeta(n, 2.2, 1.2) * 100, 5, 99.9), 1), NA_real_) adult_bmi <- if_else(child, NA_real_, round(clamp(exp(rnorm(n, log(28), 0.17)), 18.5), 1)) # Heavier participants are more likely to have blood drawn, and their # cholesterol and glucose run higher: the labs are missing at random given BMI. weight_z <- if_else(child, (bmi_percentile - 50) / 29, (adult_bmi - 28) / 5) blood_drawn <- runif(n) < if_else(   child,   plogis(-0.4 + 1.2 * weight_z),   plogis(1.6 + 0.03 * (age - 50) + 0.9 * weight_z) )  survey <- tibble(   id = sprintf("S%03d", seq_len(n)),   age = age,   sex = sex,   # MEPA: servings per day   olive_oil = rpois(n, 0.8),   green_leafy_vegetables = rpois(n, if_else(child, 0.6, 0.8)),   other_vegetables = rpois(n, 1.2),   whole_grains = rpois(n, 1.6),   # MEPA: servings per week (sweets include sugary drinks under age 6)   berries = rpois(n, 2),   other_fruit = rpois(n, if_else(child, 7, 5)),   meat = rpois(n, 4),   fish = rpois(n, 1.2),   chicken = rpois(n, 2.5),   cheese = rpois(n, 3),   butter_cream = rpois(n, 3),   beans = rpois(n, 1.5),   sweets_and_pastries = rpois(n, if_else(child, 6, 4)),   nuts = rpois(n, 2),   alcohol = if_else(age < 18, 0L, rpois(n, 3)),   fast_food = rpois(n, 1.2),   # Physical activity   active_play_minutes = if_else(preschool,                                  round(rgamma(n, 6, scale = 25)),                                 NA_real_),   moderate_activity_minutes =      if_else(preschool,              NA_real_,              round(               rgamma(n, 1.3, scale = if_else(child, 140, 85)))             ),   vigorous_activity_minutes =      if_else(preschool,              NA_real_,              round(rbinom(n, 1, 0.5) * rgamma(n, 1.2, scale = if_else(child, 80,                                                                      45)))             ),   # Nicotine and sleep   smoking_status = smoking_status,   years_since_quit = if_else(!child & smoking_status == "former",                               round(runif(n, 0, 25), 1), NA_real_),      current_inhaled_nds = smoking_status != "current" &      age >= 13 & runif(n) < if_else(child, 0.12, 0.05),      secondhand_smoke_home = runif(n) < 0.12,      sleep_hours = round(2 * rnorm(n,                                  case_when(preschool ~ 11,                                            under_13 ~ 9.5,                                            child ~ 7.6, .default = 7), 1)) / 2,      # BMI: adults in kg/m^2, children as CDC percentiles   bmi = adult_bmi,   bmi_profile = if_else(child,                          NA_character_,                          if_else(runif(n) < 0.1, "asian_pacific", "general")),   bmi_percentile = bmi_percentile,   bmi_percent_of_p95 = if_else(     bmi_percentile >= 95,     round(100 + rexp(n, 1 / 12), 1),     round(clamp(100 - (95 - bmi_percentile) * 0.45, 60, 99.9), 1)   ),      # Laboratory values (masked below where no blood was drawn)   non_hdl_cholesterol =      round(       clamp(         rnorm(n,               if_else(child,                        112 + 14 * weight_z,                        138 + 0.3 * (age - 50) + 12 * weight_z),               if_else(child, 22, 32)), 50)),      lipid_lowering_treatment = !child & runif(n) < plogis(-3.5 + 0.05 * age),   diabetes = diabetes,   glucose_measure = if_else(diabetes, "hba1c", "fasting_glucose"),      glucose_value = case_when(     diabetes ~ round(clamp(rnorm(n, 7.4, 1.1), 6.5), 1),     .default = round(       clamp(rnorm(n, if_else(child, 88, 95) + 5 * weight_z, 10), 65, 125)       )   ),      # Blood pressure, with AAP 2017 thresholds for ages 1-12   systolic_bp =      round(       rnorm(n,             if_else(child, 96 + 1.4 * age, 121 + 0.35 * (age - 50)),             if_else(child, 9, 14))),      diastolic_bp = round(     rnorm(n, if_else(child, 56 + 0.9 * age, 77), if_else(child, 7, 9))),      systolic_bp_p90 = if_else(under_13, round(100 + 1.3 * age), NA_real_),   systolic_bp_p95 = if_else(under_13, round(104 + 1.3 * age), NA_real_),   diastolic_bp_p90 = if_else(under_13, round(62 + 0.9 * age), NA_real_),   diastolic_bp_p95 = if_else(under_13, round(66 + 0.9 * age), NA_real_),      antihypertensive_treatment = !child & runif(n) < plogis(-3.8 + 0.055 * age) )  # Keep the full values to check the imputation against later. survey_complete <- survey survey <- survey |>   mutate(     non_hdl_cholesterol = if_else(blood_drawn, non_hdl_cholesterol, NA_real_),     glucose_value = if_else(blood_drawn, glucose_value, NA_real_),     glucose_measure = if_else(       blood_drawn | diabetes, glucose_measure, NA_character_       )   ) survey |>   mutate(child = age < 20) |>   count(child) #> # title: Get started with essential8
text: essential8 computes Life’s Essential 8 (LE8) cardiovascular health scores using American Heart Association’s 2022 definitions. Subjects aged 20 years older scored using adult definitions whereas subjects aged 4 months 19 years scored using pediatric definitions; vignette scores adults, see vignette("pediatric-scoring") details pediatric scoring. vignette shows score complete incomplete data. examples use dplyr native pipe (|>, available R 4.1+). See ?score_le8 input requirements scoring details.
